tools-resources
Despite recent rainfall, our region remains in a Level 2- Significant Drought. Drought
conditions can cause private wells to dry up as prolonged periods of below-average rainfall
reduce groundwater recharge. As groundwater levels drop, the water table can fall below the
depth of a well, leaving it unable to draw enough water. Shallow wells are often more
vulnerable, particularly during extended or severe droughts.
-Learn more on Page 3!-
